user.title: Set up NBE V16 Pellet Boiler
user.description: Enter the IP address and TCP port of the EP20 or a raw TCP forwarding socket. Home Assistant connects as a TCP client and passively reads the UART byte stream without sending application data. After setup, you can enable raw TCP forwarding using the gear icon next to the integration entry.

data_description.host: IP address of the EP20 or raw TCP forwarding socket
data_description.developer_mode: Create enabled sensors for every received Z-value. Unknown values are named z… and remain unitless raw integers. Turning this off removes the extra entities from the registry and discards their custom settings. Recorder settings determine history recording.

reconfigure.title: Change TCP endpoint and developer mode
reconfigure.description: Configure the TCP endpoint for the same boiler and developer mode. Saving reloads this entry. Normal sensors retain their identity.

init.title: Raw TCP forwarding
init.description: Expose the received UART bytes through a one-way TCP socket. Disabled by default. Unencrypted and without login; raw data can include device identifiers and setup data. Bind to an explicit private or loopback IP and allow only the recipient IPs (comma separated, maximum 16). Restrict the port with your firewall; never expose it to the Internet. The receiving integration uses this address and port as its TCP endpoint. Saving reloads this entry.

error.raw_tcp_bind_failed: Cannot open the TCP listener. Check that the bind IP belongs to this Home Assistant host and that the port is free on that address.
error.invalid_raw_tcp: Use explicit private or loopback IP addresses, 1–16 client IPs separated by commas, and a TCP port from 1024 to 65535. Wildcard addresses and hostnames are not accepted.
